budget_items.what_was_said: A warrant article requests this sum from the general fund to pay legal costs for cy pres petitions to Probate and Family Court on two veterans' trust funds and the Worthy Poor fund. The petitions would update outdated trust terms tied to the now-inactive American Legion Post 283 and to obsolete poor-relief language.
The chair said this figure came directly from the town manager, who received it from the town's attorney, to cover legal work on both the Legion trust and the Worthy Poor fund.
The chair said roughly this much sits across the two dormant veterans' funds belonging to Lunenburg residents, unused because no one had operated the funds in decades.

minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Trust Fund Commission, with only the chair and vice-chairman (Richard) present, finalized and unanimously voted to advance two warrant articles for the May 2026 Annual Town Meeting: a general-fund appropriation for legal costs to pursue court (cy pres) relief updating two obsolete veterans' trust funds and the Worthy Poor fund, and a bylaw amendment letting the Select Board approve trust distributions if the commission itself lacks a quorum. Both articles pass to the Select Board (the bylaw also to the Bylaw Review Committee), with a courtesy copy to the Finance Committee; the commission also flagged a standing vacancy on its own board.

Approve the warrant article for distribution of trust funds in the absence of a quorum, with the word "municipal" stricken from line four of paragraph one.

what_happened.line: Commission voted unanimously to send Town Meeting a warrant article funding legal costs to unfreeze two dormant veterans' trust funds and the Worthy Poor fund.
A second unanimous vote advances a bylaw letting the Select Board approve trust distributions when the commission itself cannot reach quorum.
Both articles go next to the Select Board, with the bylaw also to the Bylaw Review Committee and a copy to the Finance Committee.
Only two of the commission's members, the chair and vice-chairman, were present for the meeting and both votes.

why_it_matters: Town Meeting in May will be asked to appropriate general-fund money for legal fees on a court petition to update decades-old veterans' trust language before those funds can be used.
The quorum bylaw is a process change: if this small commission can't muster a quorum, the Select Board could step in to approve trust distributions instead.
A vacancy on the Trust Fund Commission remains open, which is part of why quorum has become a live concern.
watch_next: Select Board and Bylaw Review Committee take up both warrant articles ahead of May 2026 Annual Town Meeting
